column1: # codehawks-class-keywords.tsv — first-cut, CONSERVATIVE keyword table for auto-tagging a CodeHawks finding
# with a bug-taxonomy class (../../auditor/bug-taxonomy.md). Columns (TAB-separated): class_id  keyword-regex
#   keyword-regex  a case-insensitive Python regex; a finding "matches" this class when the regex is found in
# ASSIGNMENT RULE (extract-gt-codehawks.sh): a finding is auto-tagged with a class ONLY when EXACTLY ONE class
# regex matches. On ZERO or 2+ matches the class-csv column is left BLANK and the finding is appended to the
# --needs-tagging output for a human to classify — a wrong class poisons ground truth, so ambiguity never
# guesses. The regexes are derived from each class's own `hits`/`hunt`/`breaks` prose in bug-taxonomy.md; they
# are deliberately narrow and are EXPECTED to leave many findings blank. Extend/tighten this table (a human
# edit, reviewable without touching the parser) as coverage is hand-audited — see README.md "CodeHawks GT
# extraction". Recognized RARE class: C8 (reentrancy / attacker-controlled-callee).
